# Q6 successor package (OCS-F3-Q240-FINAL), CP 739efe7d8f16a0cee1efc7dd3a978d5d4d85fe69

What it is: a bounded, pre-frozen execution of the three D-2 Q6 gaps (omitted `test_claim_journal_stage.py`, the skipped format-module test, the pin-bound `test_v02_claim_policy_binding.py`) on Python 3.11.18 and 3.12.3 against a pristine copy of CP (tree 1e7a7555...), with raw output for every first attempt.
What it is not: not a re-run of D-2 or of the green D-06 files; not an independent or organizational certification (the executor is a subordinate worker of the lead builder session that produced the readjudication, D-1 and D-2); not a qualification of the Verifier, of the runtime, or of any CP revision other than 739efe7; B is a modified successor copy, not the original test; the Verifier sha is an unpinned lead choice. Documentation and CI are not qualification (CA08).
Start with `verdict.md`; the frozen `PROTOCOL-Q6-SUCCESSOR-v1.md` (sha256 25b076db6a2220926af76314ceb7415e7358e59a2a42bb5c9fb1f07ca796ea30) holds the expectations written before any candidate execution. Layout: `harness/` (runner, gate, successor test, diff), `env/` (freezes, pins, hashes), `test-ids/`, `raw/<label>/` (invocation, stdout, stderr, junit, gate), `raw/_prefreeze-collection/` (collection-only smoke, before freeze), `manifest.json`, `SHA256SUMS` (written last; verify with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS` in this directory).
